title: Auth — Signing Key List — payload
description: An identity lists its own signing-key delegations. The payload names no subject: the identity listed is the one the document's proof resolves to, so a caller cannot ask for somebody else's. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: Auth — Signing Key List — response payload
Response.description: Every delegation enrolled for the caller's identity, newest first, revoked ones included.
